t: Bring crab spikes, underwater flowers and pearls to Ilze Korushkos in the Copper lake.

Hey! I heard you made friends with Janus? He is a good prince, but he is still too young and stupid. You should better talk to his father, Julis, but he was wounded by the rebels, and he's been unconscious for several days now.

Can you help me? When we ran from the rebels, we had to leave all our supplies behind. If you could get me some crab spikes, underwater flowers and pearls, I could revive Julis. Will you do that?
Sharp spikes can be obtained from crab shells; flowers grow on corals; and pearls, as we know, can be found in clamshells!

Excellent! Give them to me!

...

Julis feels better already! I don't have enough words to express my gratitude!
Disguise as a Nyx, get inside of the palace where Antonis Bulbas hides, and capture the traitor.

Now we need to get rid of the traitor! But I don't want to kill him. At least, not now. First he has to tell us everything he knows about the strangers from the sky!

I will disguise you as a Nyx. It won't fool the guards, but I hope you don't run into them.

Find Bulbas in the town ruins and make him speak the truth about the strangers from the sky! When other Nyxes hear the traitor speak, they will stop believing all that nonsense.

He will pay for everything!

Don't touch me! I am Antonis Bulbas, the lord of the ancient people of Nyxes! I will freeze your blood if you touch me!

Aagh! Help me! They are trying to kill me!

...

Don't kill me! Please! I will serve you! I swear!
Question Antonis Bulbas and return to Yanis Harius.
Don't touch me! What do you want?!

So that was it... Some human told that stupid tuna to rebel! All trouble comes from humans. Well, now when Bulbas made such a fool of himself, I can easily get my father's throne back.

Thank you. My people are very grateful to you.
Swim across the lake and tell the citizens of the Iron City that soon they will receive supplies from the allies.

Great news, friend!

Thank you so much! Justice has been finally served. Nyxes will start repairing the pipe right away. You just need to warn the citizens. They still think that Nyxes are traitors and will start shooting at them as soon as they show up on the surface!

We will fix the pipe, and other humans will be able to walk through it safely. For a fee, of course.

Hey, guys, just look at that blockhead!

What are you doing here, you weirdo? I haven't met you before...

I am Hoof, the right hand of Ivan Chelezny, the master of these lands. Tell me who you are!
Bring 12 cut treants' branches to Khuus-Juchi.
Ha! I knew that you would do it, kylys.
Find the lost tools on the swamp near the Copper lake and return them to Semyon Derevin.

Hey!

Please, help me! You see, I am a wood worker. I was drafted in to help the Pridens build a corduroy across the swamp, but... I lost my instruments!

I was going to cut some trees for the raft, and then one of them opened its eyes and looked right at me! I got so scared I ran for my life - and lost all my instruments on the way. What am I going to do without them?

Please, can you look for them?
Please, bring me my instruments back!
Excellent! Thanks to your courage, the repairing works will be done in time.
Try to reach the other side of the Copper lake on the raft while fighting off the Architects. If you fail, return to Khuus-Juchi.

It's all ready, kylys. We couldn't fix the ferry, but we built a top-notch raft, eysh! There are not so many Architects in this part of the allod, but I've seen some flying over the lake. It looks like they didn't notice us, but you should still watch out. And don't fall into the lake - some bloodthirsty beasts dwell on its bottom!

Just reach the other side and tell the locals that help is on the way!
Let me know when you are ready - I will tell my warriors to launch the raft.
Are you alright, kylys? You don't look well! What happened?
Fight the dwellers of the Copper lake until they answer why they attacked the soldiers. Return to Khuus-Shosha.

The Architects exploded the raft, and the lake dwellers almost drowned you? Shoysh! That smells like treason.

We need to find out what got into the heads of those underwater hunhurrs! If they are going to keep on sinking our boats, we will never cross the lake. Beat them up, if you have to.
Find a water dweller and beat them up until they speak! They never used to attack humans, eysh. This is strange.

This is funny, eysh! Nyxes have never attacked humans before. I bet those Guards of Order are the Architects! The enemy is much more guileful than we thought.

Well, if the Architects could saw dissention among the lake folk, it means that they are not so numb after all, zoor?

It's Antonis! He makes us do that. The Guards of the Order gave him a great power. He says he will use it drive all humans away from the lake shores!

When Julis tried to contradict, Antonis almost killed him. It sparked off a real rebellion! Prince Janis fled with his wounded father, and I wanted to leave with them - but I was too scared. Let me go, please! I don't want to fight.
h: Ask why the lake people are attacking the boats

t: Find friendly Nyxes in the Copper lake and find out why humans are being attacked.

I wonder how the Architects managed to win over Nyxes. Don't they see that those aliens don't care about any living being?

It's too bad me and my brother cannot swim. I am afraid it's you who will have to find out the truth.
What are you doing in our lake?! Answer me!
Ask Janis about Nyxes and ask him to help you cross the lake.

Are you not on the traitors' side? I don't believe you!

What do you want from Janis Harius, the prince of the lake folk?
What do you want from me? I'm not the prince anymore!
If the strangers from the sky really are your enemies, then prove it! Maybe then I will help you cross the lake.
Bring tails of Nyx Guards to Janis Harius.

You want me to trust you? Prove you're on our side!

Antonis is establishing all sorts of ridiculous laws. Now everyone has to work "for the common good" from dawn till sunset. It's a lie! It's only good for Antonis and his accomplices. They make their people gather mussels on the bottom and bring them to the palace, where the impostors eat them all, leaving just empty shells to the common folks. If anyone dares to complain, they just cut their tails off!

I say, a tail for a tail! Bring me the tails of the traitors, and maybe then I will believe you.
Try not to kill civilians. It's not heir fault. They were fooled by nasty slug Antonis!
Great! When I take over my palace again, I will hang their tails in the hall to remind others what is the price of treachery!
Take away the royal chain, the crown and the scepter from Urmas, Peters and Valdis and return to Janis Harius.

I know how to help you. But first you need to bring me the royal regalia of my father. Crazy Antonis gave them away to his accomplices as simple trinkets. It is such a shame for our people! Without my father’s regalia, I cannot regain my power.

The accomplices' names are Urmas, Peters and Valdis. They must be chilling somewhere in the town outskirts. Take away the crown, the scepter and the orb of Harius dynasty, and I swear you will have all the help I can offer!
Urmas, Peters and Valdis are hiding in the old town ruins, not far from my palace. My former palace...

I didn't expect you to do it so fast! Now with the royal regalia, I can recover my lost throne and help you, as I promised!

Have you seen that huge pipe on the bottom of the lake? When my father was young, smugglers built that tunnel to transport goods to the Iron City. They paid us well! But then all smugglers were drowned by Ivan Chelezny, and thus our thrift ended.

When I recover my power, I can fix the tunnel. But you will have to pay us again, like in the old times!
Complete the quests from Whip, Hoof, Yela Komelkova and Paul de Blizare in the Iron City, then return to Hoof.

An Alliance ambassador? I couldn't care less who you are. Don't you see what is going on? The monsters are literally deluging the city. They fall from the sky; they come from under the ground - the whole city is a battlefield. I don't have the time to listen to what you have to say.

You wanna help? Then do it! Fight the bastards and protect the civilians!
Hey ambassador! Or is it dumb-assador? Haha!
You are good! If at least a quarter of the Alliance are fighters like you, then everything is not lost yet!
Use Phase-inverting Transductor to extract cores of the Architects, locked in the western part of the Iron City, and bring them to Eladia.

You again? Wait... Haven't we met before? Are you sure? Your face looks familiar.

I am Eladia, one of Catherina's students. The mistress is really interested in studying the Architects. A new form of life! Can you imagine how much we can accomplish if we use that knowledge in our technologies?

You can help us if you want. Catherina needs cores, hidden beneath the shell of every Architect. Usually they explode when the carcass is damaged, but I invented a device that can help us capture intact cores. Some ten will be enough for the experiments.
First you need to hit an Architect with something heavy, like stones or a hammer. As soon as its surface starts cracking, push the button - and its core will jump right into your hands.
The core seems to be intact. It means it is fully functional and sensitive to the environment. Let's see how it will enjoy our experiments...
Extract cores from shell craters in the Iron City and bring them to Eladia.

You know that the Architects deploy their scouts here along with the bomb shells? Ah, so you were that assistant that Paul spoke so highly of!

Then I guess you know what I am going to ask you of. We need to collect cores from the craters. I will examine them to determine at which moment they activate, do they need an external source of energy and so on. Will you help me?
Extract a core from a crater is much easier than from a living Architect. Just aim your Transducer on a crater and push the button!
How interesting! It seems like these cores are dormant. They almost do not glow and do not radiate energy. So what activates them?
Charge four magical obelisks in the Iron City and return to Innocent Chudin.

How am I supposed to charge them all at once? I don't have ten arms!

Hey you! Are you ready to serve your motherland? I can see that you are!

Here, take this. This is a charger for the Talisman. Yes, that dome that protects the streets from the shellfire. The obelisks that generate the power field run out of energy before we can recharge them, causing breaches in the dome. So go on and charge four of them right now, before we get squashed!
Just bring this thing close to the obelisk and wait until it starts glowing.
You are right in time. The Architects seem to be firing all arms that they have. It's good to have the Talisman protecting us!
With the help of Inguz, find Architect scouts in the Iron City and return to Nikita Karasupin.

You see them? Do you? Neither do I. But my dog can smell them a mile away!

Those tiny nasty Architects are hiding and watching, looking for something... But we will track them down and kill each and every one of them!

You don't believe me? Ha! Take my dog and walk around the block - you will see what I am talking about.
If Inguz wanders away, just whistle and wave the leash - he will be right back.
Now you see how insidious these monsters are? But Inguz is not so easily fooled, too!
Find the destroyed supply wagon in the city, repair the crystals and return to Odric de Desirae.

Ah, so you are that Alliance hero who wants to help us fight the Architects? Well, go ahead!

Our cannons use special focusing crystals that allow shooting not only in the Astral, but in any environment. They help us a big deal against the Architects. It's too bad though that the crystals often collapse, and without then a cannon is just a piece of metal.

The supply wagon was supposed to arrive here an hour ago, but it is still nowhere to be seen. What if something happened to it on the way?
Please, hurry! If the Architects attack again, we will have to fight them with our bare hands.
I knew something was wrong. I hope the Architects don't realize the importance of those crystals for us, otherwise we're screwed...
Use the cannon to repel the attack of the Architects and return to Odric de Desirae.

Ah, they keep on swarming! Can you believe that? As if they know we're in trouble...

What are you waiting for? Load the cannon and shoot to kill!
It's simple, just aim and press here...
You have a sharp eye! Well done, friend.
Wait until Eladia finishes the experiment and speak to her.

I've conducted a couple of experiments... Well, I can't say they were totally abortive... Alright, I have two cores left. I hope this time everything will work!

You know what's the most weird ability of our enemy? It's synthesis! Small and weak creatures can join into a huge, strong and smart monster. I strive to find out how they do that! Will you assist me?
Watch out - I may be wrong!

Wow! I've never seen a monster speak before! Are they all like that? Or is it just this species? I should try crossbreeding them...

Well, this experiment definitely was successful. Now it is official - two small creatures cam be fused into a bigger one, which is smart enough to speak, but not smart enough to see that don't need their Ascension, whatever it is!
Speak to the citizens near the town hall, in the hospital and near the alchemist's store and find out what is bothering them.

These is one thing... I don't really feel comfortable speaking about it...

Something smells wrong. Someone spreads rumors; people panic. They even want to surrender to the Architects.

You are new here. Why don't you try and speak with them? We don't need rats here at the height of the war...
Just be delicate. Don't ask direct questions - we don't want to give ourselves away.

Unbelievable... My trusted people are ready to stab me in the back! Was that Rohlin alone? I would never believe that! There must be someone else.

Find those who print the leaflets. They will give us more information.
Meet Snoot the Hungry at the frontline behind the gates of the Iron City.

The Alliance vanguard has already arrived and set out to the frontline. We will deal with the rest of the traitors, and you should meet Snoot immediately.

Be careful. Don't let the orcs do anything reckless.

Hey there! You have somethin' to eat? I'm freakin' stravin'!

Nah? That's too bad. Alright, let's deal with what you have here.
Destroy the Architects in the streets of the Iron City and return to Whip.

Hoof sent you to help us? This isn't really the reinforcement I expected... but never mind.

The monsters are everywhere! While people are hiding in their houses, we need to clear the streets to give them a safe passage to our fortifications.
You are good. You must have had your share as a mercenary, too, right? We don't have many options here on Dane. You are either a Free Trader's mercenary, or a farmer...
Search the yard and find out what happened to Yela Komelkova's family.

Oh... Do you know what happened to my family?

When the war broke out, I started working at the hospital and haven't showed up in my house much ever since. Wwhile battles were still rumbling outside of the city walls, I didn't worry about them - they were safe. But now the monsters are everywhere, and anything could have happened to my parents!

Please, go and see if they are alright! Our house is just opposite the warehouse near the eastern wall.
Please, find my family! I'm so worried for them...

Died?.. Oh no... How it happened? I must know!

...

Oh no! Only complete lunatics could have sacrificed innocent people to these monsters... They won't resurrect now!! Those who were sacrificed do not resurrect!!

I swear on the Light, I will revenge! I can shoot! I will fight the bastards until the last breath of the last of them!
Collect 12 swords from the dead bodies and give them to soldiers near the warehouse, the hospital, and the alchemist's store.

If you really wanna help, I have somethin' for ya.

We are runnin' short on decent weapons. You can't break through the monsters' shell with a simple bow! So, half of our guards are defenseless, and half of them are lying breathless in the streets.

So go and pick some weapons from the dead bodies. And don't let the monsters destroy the warehouse, the hospital and the alchemy store! Otherwise we are left with nothin'.
If you see a sword - grab it and bring to my soldiers. Those who guard the warehouse, the hospital and the alchemists are fighting barehanded!
I know, it's not a pleasant task, but those who are still alive need those weapons more.
Ask the guards in the city whether they have seen how the Architects get inside of the city, examine shell craters and return to Paul.

Good day, friend! I see you are not afraid of the monsters. Maybe I could ask you for a favor?

You see, I'm very confused. The monsters have been bombing our city for several days now, but they never appeared in the streets before. We are securing the walls and the lake, so how are they getting in? I cannot understand that.

I would be very grateful if you could speak with our people in other shelters. Maybe they know something?

Unexploded shells... Jump out from under the ground... From under the ground, that's it!

As far as I have learned from the battle reports, our enemies consist of a core, upon which they grow their flesh. And now they deploy their cores into the city under the guise of artillery shelling, and then grow their bodies when they are already inside - and then emerge right from under the ground!
Take barrels with soil oil from the warehouse and use them to burn the Architect germs at the bottoms of the shell craters. Return to Paul de Blizare.

Well, now that we know their secret, we're on the half way to victory! We will burn them all, and you will help me with that.

There must be several barrels with soil oil left in the warehouse. It burns brighter than goblin's eyes at the sight of gold! All we have to do is find all the shell craters, fill them with the oil, and throw a match! I'm sure the Architect germs won't survive that!

The fire does its work!

Let me express my sincere gratitude! Now the guards just have to finish the few survivors, and the city will be safe again.
Meet Ivan Chelezny in the Iron City town hall.

Alright, you don't need me. I'm not empowered to make any decisions... Not yet, huh.

If you are an ambassador, you should head straight to the town hall. There you will find my boss and my king, Ivan Chelezny. You should talk to him, not to me - I'm a mere soldier.

Greetings. I am Ivan Chelezny, a Tycoon and the ruler of this city.

If I understand correctly, you are the ambassador who was supposed to tell me something extremely important. About the establishment of the Alliance, I suppose? Well, save your breath. An Alliance sorceress has already been here and told me the wonderful news.

We should reinforce our defenses so that they last until the Alliance forces arrive...

The Demon Hunters noticed monsters that you call the Architects near Dane just several days before they attacked the White Fortress. They came from the depth of the Astral, where no ships sail. Somehow they reached Sarnaut bypassing Portals and wormholes. How? I have no idea.
These are hard times... but we won't give up! We'll make it through! We'll win!

It is fantastic indeed that the League and the Empire could forget the old strife for a while and join their forces. Without them, we would have lasted just another day or two. Can you imagine my surprise when that sorceress - Eladia - appeared out of thin air and told me that the Shore City had been already liberated by the Alliance!

Who could have thought...

Honestly, I haven't been that happy since I entered the Council of Seven.
Complete the quests from Odric de Desirae, Nikita Karasupin, and Innocent Chudin. Return to Ivan Chelezny.

I wonder why the monsters chose to attack my allod. What do we have here that they don't have on other allods? Why not Coldberg, where they don't have a Great Mage, too? Why Dane?

This is not a question that is going to be answered any time soon. While the capital is under attack, we need to concentrate on the defenses. I could use your help, too... We need to hold on until the Alliance troops arrive!
I am grateful for the good news. I will be even more grateful if you help us repel the Architects.
Perfect, just perfect. I have just received a message, saying that the Alliance soldiers will soon be here. I wish I had more soldiers like you to command the surviving squadrons!
Destroy the Architects on the western fortification and return to Snoot the Hungry.

Listen to me. We have a clear objective: destroy the cannons that are firing at the city.

They seem to be allocated in the northern camp. But we can't just go in there, can we? We need a strategy, right!

Near the collapsed western bridge the monsters have built another fortification. Let's make some fuss there, and when the guards from the northern camp rush there - that's when we sneak in.
Don't chicken out! Kill them all!
Huh, did you see them rush? Before they know it, we will grind their cannons to dust!
Plant mines on the platforms in the northern camp and return to Snoot the Hungry.

So the plan is: you break into the camp, you plant mines, and you get out. Sounds simple, but there are nuances.

Their cannons shoot from special platforms. Every now and then they move away from them to recharge or reload - I don't know for sure. As soon as a cannon leaves the platform, run up to it, plant a mine and retreat. When the cannon comes back and touches the mine... Boom!

I think it's gonna work!
Bide your time, plant a mine, run for your life. It's simple!
Whoa, that was quite a kaboom! I bet they didn't expect that. Now we'll see who gets the last laugh!
Escort the Alliance convoy to Kurbatskoe field and report on the arrival to the Screamer Family.

Before the Architects besieged the Iron City, the hastily drafted militia army was battered in the battle on Kurbatskoe field. Now the higher command decided to recapture that strategical site.

When our convoy set out to the field, you have to go with them. Make sure the Architects don't destroy Catherina's Aegis - that aggregate is way too important.
Hey... What Are you doing here? And where is that thing... You know, that huge white thing we had to guard?
Find out what happened to the soldiers’ bodies on Kurbatskoe Field, and destroy the Soulless and Exarkhs. Return to the Screamer family.

All we know is that we are here, and they are there. Not too much, right? That's why I need to send you on a scouting mission.

For now, we have only seen the empty-eyed dummies and the creatures that control them, but we haven't come across a single dead body of our warriors. Where are they?

So please, go and see around. We will launch the assault upon the command.

Are you serious? They turn bodies into dust? This is horrifying! This means they will not resurrect!

The worst thing is that we can't spread this information. Fear will paralyze the army better than any cannon. So keep your mouth shut!
Speak to the guard and reach Full Moon.
All that we can do now is launch a counter attack... Wait, another scout is back! What does he have to say?
An ultra-modern weapon turned into a pile of metal. What good is your progress? Although... Maybe we can still do something.
Enter the Kurbatskoe field Distortion and defeat the Architects with the help of Full Moon.

The space around Full Moon and its misfortunate crew flows and trembles. The death of the mechanics seems to be a key event, and if we avert the destruction of Full Moon, we can change the outcome of the battle. There's not much hope, but we should try it anyway!
The shatters of the giant Architect produce an aura of terror and otherworldly chill. The good thing is, it won't hurt anyone in Sarnaut anymore.
O, hello! You marvel at the beauty of Full Moon, too? Indeed it's a splendid ship with a professional crew. We will give some hell to those Architects!
Gather the soldiers, finish the retreating Architects and break into their world.

After the death of the Warlord, the rest of the Architects' army started retreating on all fronts. Now we need to finish the fleeing enemies while following them into their world, and then eliminate the alien threat once and for all!
A great chance to finish the enemy with one powerful strike!

Hush, hush...

It's alright. You are safe, in the Shore City. Come on, let us take a look at you.
Complete the quests from the citizens in the capital, then meet Ivan Chelezny.

It's been unquiet here in the Iron City. Hoof is nowhere to be seen, too, which also troubles me. It's not what I'm paying him for!

You don't have any important commitments right now, do you? Please, go and speak with the citizens. Ask what is bothering them. After everything that you’ve done, they will trust in you.
We are in such a mess here!

Finally, we can have a moment of peace.

By the way, that redhead sorceress, Eladia, came looking for you. She wanted me to tell you something important, but I forgot what it was...
Go down the mine, find Hoof and his accomplices, deal with the traitor and return to Ivan Chelezny.

Hoof and his accomplices practice a strange religion. They believe that there is a Prophet, and that the Architects speak through his lips. Supposedly, the Prophet calls to bow before the Architects, for only they can establish the order in our world and achieve the eternal peace and prosperity. Of course, people are tired of war, and they can be easily tricked by such promises. Some of my fellow soldiers fell for it, too...

Hoof and Swish went down the shaft not so long ago. They must be still there.

A treason in the heart of the capital! How could I have missed it? I guess I'm getting too old...

So they blew up the lower levels of the mine? This actually makes sense. There is no other way to cross the mountains, and the northern part of the allod is occupied by the Architects...

Alright, we will get them, but for now we need to stop the spread of that heresy. The people are scared to death already, and we don't need that Prophet thing get into their heads. Well, I will deal with that myself.
Pacify the Nyxes and find out the reason of their outbreak. Return to Ilze Korushkos.

The Nyxes are getting on your fishermen's nerves? I got nothing to do with that! They are a pain in the neck for us, too.

A couple of days ago the shell collectors went insane. They don't recognize anyone and attack their friends! I don't know what to do - they won't listen to me. If you wish, you can try and talk to them yourself.
If you wish to speak with the rebels, go on and try. I know they won't listen to me.
Blue water? I've never heard of such thing!
I can't breathe! A grey veil in front of my eyes... I can't think... Every sound is as loud as thunder! It hurts!
h: Ask about the reason of Nyx's aggression

t: Blue water! There, near the pier... Blue like blood!
h: Ask about the reason of Nyx's aggression

t: Sorcery! Old human sorcery! They poison the water, poison our minds... We are fishers, not warriors... But we feel so much anger!
h: Ask about the reason of Nyx's aggression

t: Meet Janis Harius on the bottom of the Copper lake.

Hello there. We are in trouble here again - the Nyxes have gone nuts. They cut our fishing nets, pierce our boats, scare the fish... but we can't even touch them, you know. What if they mess with the tunnel?

Who can possibly settle this for us?..
Hey there! Thank you again for helping me return my father's throne. What brings you under the water again?
Use the magic shell to find the traces of sorcery in the lake and return to Ilze Korushkos.

Blue water... It must be some evil magic. Human magic, because you humans like evil sorcery! Take no offence, it is true.

I think I know what to do. Here, take this magic shell. It hears the song of magic! It will help us find the source of the sorcery.
Find the source of the sorcery with this magical shell!
It's very weird... Fish, crabs and our fellow folks sound the same - there is no magic in them. But there is some in the rebels - and you!
Drink the magic potion, follow the traces of evil magic, find its source, collect several samples and return to Ilze Korushkos.

I bet it is human magic, and you, human, will help me trace it!

I have a potion that allows seeing magic. If there are evil charms in the water, you will see them. Just find the source of the sorcery and bring me some samples of it. I will try and find a way to deal with it.
Drink the potion, and you will start seeing the traces of evil magic in the lake.

Here it is! Do you smell it? Ah, sorry, you can't smell under the water.

It makes me dizzy, and also makes me want to tear someone apart... Ah, what a nasty thing!
Return to Ivan Chelezny and demand that he stops the production that contaminates the lake.

You see, it's all humans' fault! That evil magic almost got us to kill each other!

You must be some important person, aren't you? They will listen to you. Tell their king to stop the nasty production, or we will revoke our collaboration and stop repairing the tunnel! Tell him that we object!

What do those fish... I mean, our allies think they are doing?! The underwater tunnel is the only way to get from the Shore City to the Iron City!

They don't like the "poisonous thing"? It's not a "thing", it's the residues of a first-class stimulator that we transport to the frontline and that keeps our soldiers fighting on!

Of course I will find the one who is responsible for spilling the potion into the lake, but there is no way we can stop its production. We will have to find a compromise.
Inspect all suspicious back streets in the city with Whip and return to Graymane.

Hey there! So Ivan sent you to help us? Glad to hear that - we could use any help we get. There are so many marauders in the city! They would kill their own mother for a dime. We don't have enough people to keep an eye on all of them.

You see Whip over there? Some muggers beat up his partner, and I can't send him alone to patrol the streets. If you could go with him, that would be great.
Just listen to Whip. He knows what he is doing.

You?!

But what about Whip...

Where's Whip?!
Ask Graymane about the reason of Whip's treason and return to the refugee camp.

What are you saying? Who tried to kill you? Don't you dare to bark up the wrong tree!

You must have had a fight, right? What was it about? Money? Booze? Come on, spit it out!
Examine Sharashkin's body and his stuff in the refugee camp, then talk to Saad-Ankha.

Sharashkin? What do you care about him? You weren't even a friend of his!

...

You say, a matter of national security? Oh my!

You're too late - Sharashkin's dead. Somebody killed him just several minutes before you arrived. I only had the time to give an order to guard his tent.

Now I see he wasn't killed because of a cup of soup!

Now that you're here, you're in charge. Sharashkin's tent is on the other side of the camp. Tell me when you finish.
Sharashkin was not a particularly good person, but I am responsible for every man who dies here.

Let me think... I swear on the ancestors, I know who this axe belongs to!

Sharashkin used to be friends with that orc, Swish. He has a very rugged face, like those who work in the mines!
Reach the mine in the east part of the Iron City, find Sharashkin's killer and find out who stands behind the propaganda.

I bet this will lead us to the mine. The one who owns the mines, owns Dane. All this plotting with the fanatics is nothing more than a distraction. What they really want is to overthrow Ivan Chelezny from the throne, mark my word.

If you want to find out the truth, go the mines. They are located to the east from the city gates. Be careful!

No need to keep secrecy now that we know that the mine is in the traitors' hands! Meteorite ore and gold - that's the source of Dane's prosperity. And it seems that Hoof and his gang are trying to take advantage of the turmoil and appropriate the mine. And not only the mine!
Who are you? What do you want?
What do you mean, swish? The mine is closed! You better go away.
What are you talking about? Go to the city and buy there everything you need! They have all sorts of swishes.
I told you to get lost! You had your chance, now you're coming with us!
Get crystals from the streetlamps in the Shore City and bring them to Kazimir Pakhomov.

Hey there! I'm Kazimir, the Portal Keeper. When the stone monsters attacked, all spatial magic collapsed at once. Thought connection doesn't work, the Portals are messed up. We had to send messenger pigeons to the Iron City! Can you believe that?

I suppose we can solve the problem if we find a sustainable source of power. Where do we get it? Oh, I know!

Last year elves installed their streetlamps in the city. They said, they would work forever, because they charge from magic crystals. If I had those crystals, I could fix the Portals in no time. But who in their sober senses would dare to go to the city?
I wish we had a mana-station...

Just what I need. Let's try it...

Look, it works! I don't think it will sustain an army, but for sporadic single travels it will work just fine.
Kill biters and steel perches in the Copper lake, then return to Janis Harius.

You are the best friend of the lake folk, aren't you? Will you do us a favor?

We haven't been paying enough attention to the fish farm recently, and now the lake is swarming with horrible predatory fish, who kill off our live stock. If you could help us reduce their population, we would be very grateful!
Get rid of the rest of the nasty perches and biters!
Thank you so much! You are a real friend of the lake folk.
Kill the wolves in the grove near the refugee camp and report to Saad-Ankha.

I told Saad-Ankha: you cannot send hunting those who were raised among stones and factory smoke, eysh! They make the forest angry. Look what you've done - they're all dead!

I survived by a miracle. I just climbed up the tree and had to watch the animals devour their bodies...

Once a beast tastes blood, it will attack again and again. We have to kill them now, eysh!
Nature demands harmony. You cannot just hunt for fun; you have to give something in return.
Find the hunters in the grove near the refugee camp.

Here you see those who ran away from grief, death and starvation. A sorry sight...

These people are tired and desperate. I need someone to help me take care of them.

I sent several tailless to hunt in the grove, but they still haven't returned. Could you go and check on them? It's been a while.
Very little remained of the hunters...
Find the wolf pack leader and kill him. Return to Saad-Ankha.

I've never seen wolves attacking people for no reason. But those just jumped out of the bushes and started tearing at our throats... And their leader was horrifying. Such a huge and ugly beast... and I think it was sentient, too! Then the wolves left, and the leader ordered several of them to guard the tree and wait until I'm ready to drop. Luckily, you showed up...

No one can kill just for fun! But we can kill to revenge!

Kill the beast! His blood for our blood, eysh!
Destroy the pack leader. He is the most dangerous!
A werewolf?! Are you serious? I've never seen one before! It's good that we killed it. It could have done things much worse...
Escort Khuus-Unana to the camp and tell Saad-Ankha what happened.

We have to go back...

I can barely walk and can't run at all. Will you walk me to the camp, zoor? I'm too scared to go on my own...
I sent Khuus-Unana to hunt with the tailless. I hope they bring a lot of game, eysh!
The hunters were killed by wolves? Shoish! How many more will die in this war?!
Help Valdis Barbus plug all air leaks in the tunnel and remove all shellfish from the walls.

You see, we are fulfilling our part of the agreement - maintaining the tunnel in the working state! But the walls are old, and leaks open up every now and then. And shellfish on the walls contribute to that, too. If you want to help me plug the leaks and get rid of the shellfish - you are welcome!
Make sure the tunnel is airtight!
Thanks for your help! I hope the tunnel will last long enough to ensure our victory over the strangers from the sky!
Make the besotted Nyxes drink the infusion and return to Ilze Korushkos.
I made an antidote for that poisonous thing the citizens pour into our lake! Will you help me give it to the poor besotted Nyxes - or make them drink it, if you have to?
Just make them drink the antidote.

Ah, this is great! Let me kiss you!

I hope this nightmare is over, and we will live in peace ever after!
Deliver the required stones to the foot of the collapsed bridge in the Copper lake and return to Julis Harius.

Welcome to our waters! I haven't really thanked you for what did for our people - I was too weak and weary. Thank you so much!

We need to help the humans repair the collapsed bridge, but we are just running out of hands. Could you please give us a hand once again? We need to deliver the right stones to the construction site. The workers will certainly mess it up. You won't have to carry them yourself - we have specially trained crabs for this purpose.
If the crab gets tired, don't believe it - it's bluffing. Just give it an invigorating kick!
Perfect, just perfect! We will finish the work on time.
Kill the Jaw and return to Oles Brednev.

We have another trouble. Several days ago we discovered a giant monster, who dwells in the lake. It already ate six fishermen! Fishing has become a very dangerous enterprise, but what do we do without fish? How do we feed the whole city?

If you think of fighting it, don't go on your own. You will never make it.
I've been fishing for all my life, but I have never seen anything like this!
You killed the monster? Great news!
Help Nicole de Ardeur clear the walls of the Iron City.

Hi! I'm Nicole. I'm an artist.

When I arrived to Dane as a volunteer, I was sure that I can find beauty in anything. Even death can be beautiful! But I was wrong. There is nothing beautiful about war. So the faster we win it, the faster this nightmare will end.

And there are those who wish to surrender! What a cowardice! I have to erase all those defeatist slogans and leaflets on the walls. If you have a couple of spare minutes, I could use your help.
I draw beautiful pictures on the leaflets, but if you are not so good at drawing - just paint them over.
Thank you so much! I am an artist, not a soldier. But art has its power, too!
Collect Silverblooms in the Iron City vicinity and bring them to Daryona Goresvetova.

What do you need? A painkiller? A tranquilizer? A laxative?

Nothing? Ah, what a surprise! It happens so that this time I need something. Can you please collect some Silverblooms outside the city? No healing potion can be brewed without them, and I am running short on my supplies. Will you help?
Silverbloom is an extremely powerful healing remedy! One drop of its highly concentrated essence can pull an army out of the Purgatory!
Thank you so much! I have a little gift for you.
Kill Hydras on the swamp near the Iron City and return to Mikhail Kolchugin.

Ah, you just can't go anywhere without stepping on a hydra! They are especially dangerous at night - they silently crawl up at you... and sink their teeth in your leg!

Listen, I cannot leave my position. Could you please teach those nasty things a lesson? We will pay you generously.
How come there are so many of them here?!
Well done! Thank you so much!
Show the heart of the defeated monster to Mikhail Kolchugin near the Iron City gates.
The defeated monster must have caused a lot of trouble for the unfortunate citizens. Its black heart is pulsating in your hands. If you show to the city guards, you may receive a generous reward.
Wow, it must have been a huge beast! This victory deserves a good reward!

Ah, don't you even try to escape my trap!

After you beat up my daddy and hound him out from Sarnaut, I've been looking forward to his return. I've spent so much time and efforts to create an Astral bubble, where usual laws of magic do not work. Here my will is the law!

According to my calculations, anyone who has recently used temporal magic will be locked here. Temporal magic doesn't just temporary shift the tissue of reality, like your psionicists do, but attempts to alter the whole existence. No one in Sarnaut should be capable of that - it is a divine power. And you are no god!

So, answer me. What. Are. You. Doing. Here?!
You better hurry up. The time here flows differently than in Sarnaut.

You really confused me. I don't know what these Architects are and where do they come from. I will have to investigate that! It's a shame though I can't create another trap like that. I didn't expect you to show up - it was supposed to work on anyone who tried to reshape the reality, not on a victim of circumstances!

Anyway, it's better to suffer for two minutes than to turn into dust on the chronicle pages, right? I really didn't expect anyone to use temporal magic as a weapon and try to reverse teleportation!
Find the pirate camp on the southern shore of Asee-Teph near the ruins of Uksul and find out what happened to Igor Kuznetsov.

We didn't mean that! We thought you were a bandit.

Some cutthroats came looking for Igor several days ago. Since then, we haven't seen him. We thought you were one of them, too.

If I were a pirate, I would have moored in a harbor near Uskul. You should look for them there.
Oh, you are right in time!
It's decided - I am coming back.

I will pay my debts, find a couple of reliable guys and will be right there on Umoir.

Thank you one more time. Go to Catherina and tell her that I'm just the right person to take the charge of Eclipse!

So you're back! Right in time. My engineers have finally fixed the reactor, and Eclipse is ready to set off.

Ah, I wish I didn't have to leave Umoir. My disciple can keep it from being devoured by the Astral, but who will keep an eye on those idlers? Ruling demands a heavy hand!
Talk to Klavdia and deliver her message to Yasker.

The clock is ticking. While we are talking, several days might have passed in Sarnaut, so listen to me closely.

The Architects are a threat. If they keep on changing and transforming the structure of existence, you won't be able to defeat them. But there are always nuances.

Sarnaut is a prison for gods. Even my daddy got his butt kicked by simple mortals, haha. If the Architects had decided to attack only one allod, it means that their hands are tied. If you stop them now, you can prevent the catastrophe. Tell it to Yasker!

What?! That crazy chick is getting in the way again! Who is she, anyway?! That's just what we were missing!

The League has sent us a message that some loony fortuneteller, who survived the events in the White Fortress, prophesies the return of the Architects! As far as I understand, she means those creatures that the scientists on Ferris messed with? But you and Elizaveta kicked them out of our world and sealed the Portal, wasn't it so? Or is something missing from the Council reports?!

Architects? Never heard of them. But I can see you are telling the truth...

So you found a passage that led beyond Sarnaut on Ferris? You stirred up a wasps' nest, and now the wasps strive for revenge? Interesting, interesting...

As far as I understand, Architects are not actually gods. They are not creators but something else. Modifiers? Probably. They can modify space as well as time...
h: Tell Klavdia Kalugina about the Architects and the assault on Dane

t:
So, what do we have here?

Huh! The new play with the old actors.

May I ask, what you are doing here?
Talk to Klavdia and deliver her message to Aidenus.

The clock is ticking. While we are talking, several days might have passed in Sarnaut, so listen to me closely.

The Architects are a threat. If they keep on changing and transforming the structure of existence, you won't be able to defeat them. But there are always nuances.

Sarnaut is a prison for gods. Even my daddy got his butt kicked by simple mortals, haha. If the Architects had decided to attack only one allod, it means that their hands are tied. If you stop them now, you can prevent the catastrophe. Tell it to Aidenus!

Klavdia Kalugina? Was she the one who stole Tep's Spark right from under your nose? What is she doing here?

Can you imagine this: I received a message from Yasker which says that some crazy fortuneteller escaped the White Fortress and now makes a fuss at the Council! Where have you been?!
Meet Andrey Molchalin in the Free Traders' camp on Eljune.

Somehow, we need to conclude a peace treaty with the League. This is just the case when a poor peace is better than a good fight. Let's give the League a chance to face the enemy avant-garde. And when they suffer huge losses - and they will - we will speak with Aidenus on very different terms.

The talks will take place on Eljune, in the Free Traders' camp. We will send there our diplomat Andrey Molchalin, and your knowledge will be our undeniable advantage.
So you were sent by Yasker to tell us about the Architects? Excellent! Let us join the meeting.

This man is not lying, believe me. If everything is really that serious, and the Architects are ready to launch a full-scale invasion, we need to act right now! I will contact my command immediately and demand putting all our military divisions on full combat alert.
Good day, comrade! How can I help you?
Meet Paul de Desirae in the Free Traders' camp on Eljune.

We may be enemies with the Empire, but the Architects threaten the whole world. I think we are now facing their avant-garde troops. Let the Empire take that strike if Yasker is so willing to spill some blood, and then we will reap the benefits of his victory.

Today our ambassadors will meet the Imperial diplomats and decide on the plan of our collaboration. The truth is that right now no one knows how do we fight against this enemy.

The talks will take place on Eljune, in the Free Traders' camp. Find Paul de Desirae, our ambassador. The fate of the world depends on these talks!
I remember your face... So you are the one who once already confronted the Architects? Pleased to meet you! It's good that you are here, since we don't know anything about them.
Wait until the end of the meeting and speak with the participants. Then talk to Ivan Kuptsov.

What is diplomacy? Diplomacy is the iron fist of threat in a velvet glove of decency. I represented the Empire even during the negotiations on the Wild Isles, and that arrogant elf has no idea what tough negotiations are. And I will show him!

I don't know what your command is thinking, but if they don't hurry up, those monsters will just finish us and then get to you. If we could just join our forces and stand up against the enemy, we would beat them in no time! So why are they wasting it...

The Imperial squareheads don't know a thing about the art of diplomacy. A good diplomat acts like a mature wine doctored with a poison - without attracting unnecessary attention, but always accomplishing the purpose. I don't think these negotiations will take too long.
Meet Catherina on Umoir. If you have not unlocked the Portal, speak with Anfisa Gulova, the Portal Keeper.

I have a very important mission for you. I have been informed on the events on Umoir and the capacity of Catherina's ship, Eclipse. The Imperial fleet still has not recovered after the catastrophe on Irdrich and isn't ready to face such an enemy.

But you saved Catherina, and now she owes you one. We need a powerful ship to stand through this battle. I hope you can convince her to lend us Eclipse.
You again? I don't know what is going on and I have nothing to do with that!

What?! You want me to lend you Eclipse? Maybe you want me to give you Sarn, too?

Eclipse is not another pleasure yacht that anyone can steer. And if you remember, you killed the only captain who could handle my ship. The reactor is just a pile of scraps, and I drained the emergency power, trying to reach Umoir. Though...
Meet Catherina on Umoir. If you have not unlocked the Portal, speak with Anfisa Gulova, the Portal Keeper.

I have a very important mission for you. It concerns Umoir and Catherina. The League fleet still has not recovered after the catastrophe on Irdrich and isn't ready to face such an enemy.

I've heard of Eclipse, Catherina's ship. I assume that that ship is a hard nut to crack even for the Architects. And since we forgave Catherina her betrayal, she owes us one. We should remind her of that.

I hate to resort to blackmailing, but we really do need that ship.
You again? I don't know what is going on and I have nothing to do with that!

If that honorable smuggler is not lying, it means that a great war lies ahead of us. And when it's upon us, there will be no time for diplomacy. I don't think something really depends on me now. I will send a message our command to urge them to put their troops on full combat alert. My mission here is over.
Greetings! I believe we have not before.
Obtain 6 charged crystals by destroying Frost Elementals on Coldberg and bring them to Catherina in Upper city.

There is a way to repair Eclipse's reactor, but I will need your help. I heard that bodies of certain Elementals, affected by the meteorite deposits on Coldberg, accumulate special crystals. They can be used to direct and enhance a focused stream of energy.

If you could get me some of those crystals, it would be great. Meanwhile, I will contact the Conclave and inquire about the severity of the threat.

Looks like this is just what we needed. I think we can fix the reactor.

I contacted both Aidenus and Yasker, and they both yell that the Architects are the biggest threat Sarnaut has ever seen. If you ask me, I think one is simply mental, and another one is too afraid to lose his throne. But alright, I will participate in this venture. Experience and knowledge are always valuable, even if I gain them in a war with nasty alien creatures!

But still we have one unresolved problem...
Use the frequency scanner to detect the required parts in the bodies of Tep mechanics who hide on the Coba Plateau, extract them and return to Catherina.

After you blew up Nomarkh Iblis' factory together with its owner, quite predictably, we've been running short on spare parts. I've replaced almost every node with details of my own design, but I am still missing one small part - a synchrophasic polymetallic high-load mana-drive.

Iblis told me that this part is an exact copy of a drive that is used in prostheses of Tep's servants. Do you think we can find some spare parts if we disassemble several surviving minions of the summoner?
Ah, that's just what we need! Those Arisen are natural-born scientists. In a manner of speaking, they serve science even after death, haha!
Meet the Daring Family in the Takalik Harbor.

When Eclipse was still in the shipyard, I hired two most talented and skillful captains in the world to steer it. You have already met Ignat Krivov, and as you can remember, he did not survive that encounter. The name of the second one was Igor Kuznetsov. When Eclipse set out to the heart of the world, he ran away to Eljune. He probably assumed that his contract had expired.

Maybe you can ask around about him in Takalik Harbor? Without a good captain, there is no much more use of Eclipse than of a fishing boat.
Hello! Are you looking for someone? Igor, maybe?
Go to the location, designated by the Daring Family.

Keep it down! Igor is not in the camp. He asked me to tell anyone who comes searching for him that he would be in the predetermined place.

Where is that? Erm... Follow this path to the west, then after you pass two big pines, turn left and go up the hill. There you will find Igor!

Hey! Why looking so angry?

Don't grab your weapon! We're just kidding...
Storm Dane, which was captured by the Architects.

By the way, your leaders have finally agreed to conclude a temporary alliance. Though nobody knows how long it will last.

The Empire army will be led by Crazystorm the Merciless, and Izbor Yavorsky is the commander of the League army. I hope they are both smart enough not to tear at each other's throats before we kick the Architects out of our world!

I don't know what those Architects are capable of, but Eclipse is a hard nut to crack even for them!

Dane is right ahead! Hmm... It looks desolated.

Crazystorm chose a sand spit in the eastern part of the allod as a landing strip. This is the only place, apart from the port, where a ship can moor. So, are we landing?
Enter the Time Distortion at the Bee Ravine and prevent the death of the advance unit. Find Crazystorm the Merciless.

It was supposed to be the Alliance camp here, but it's only silence and dead bodies. Everything is covered with fine white dust. Something terrible happened here. The only way to find out what it was is to enter another Time Distortion.

We expected anything but a poisonous mist. There is no way one can hide from it! It will get into your lungs wherever you run.

But we will find a way to fight it. I promise.
The space around the Distortion melts and shifts.
Kill the Architects near the monoliths, use the chronometer to speed up the time and return to Eladia.

The soldiers told me that you can resist the impact of the monoliths. How do you do that?

We can make some tests using this chronometer.

It can speed up the time at the foot of a monolith. Find one and switch on the chronometer. And get rid of the Architects in your way.
Find the nearest monolith and try to switch on the chronometer.

The chronometer is dead. It means my conjecture was wrong - the Architects do not alter the time. I have a suspicion that they... do not belong to our time. I don't know how to explain it.

The crazy seeress has her own theory. I don't believe it, but still we can try it out, since we have no other options.
Go to Kurbatskoe field and meet Unn.

So the arrogant sorceress failed again? I told her so!

The darkest legends of my people tell that there is such thing as the Scissors. It's a dark and great power that changes what has been predestined. One by one, it cuts the Threads of fate, striving to destroy the Tissue of Creation! And when the Scissors appear in the world, the Fate brings the Weaver to life. The Weaver has a gift to restore the cut Threads.

I believe you are the Weaver. Everything points to that. But we need to know for sure! When you are ready, find me on Kurbatskoe field.
The Pattern turns into something incredible at the time of war! Can you sense the tension of the threads?
Destroy the Architect and try to restore the cut Threads. Return to Unn.

Can't you feel it? Oh my, was I wrong after all? The legends only say that the Weaver can restore Threads, not see them.

I will try and give you part of my gift. Go to the thick of the battle and try to catch the cut Thread. If you are indeed the Weaver, you can make it!
Go to the thick of the battle and try to catch the cut Thread. If you are indeed the Weaver, you can make it!

Yes! Oh Threads! I knew it!!

If you can restore the Threads, it means that the legends are not lying! It is certain - you are the Weaver!
Destroy the Architects on Kurbatskoe field and use the chronometer when you succeed. Return to Eladia.

The Weaver?! Oh come on. There is only one power that is able to change the world - a strong will and faith. You might believe that you are restoring the Threads because you're the Weaver, but in fact it's all the matter of faith. Not only yours, but everyone who believes in you. Well, there must be laws for faith, too. Soon we will figure them out.

I fixed the broken chronometer. You want to fight? Then go fight the Architects and don't forget to push the chronometer button!
You want to fight? Then go fight the Architects and don't forget to push the chronometer button!

Two Architects instead of one? No, this isn't how it's supposed to work!

I don't understand! The chronometer created some kind of a time loop that brought another Architect - from the past or from the future - instead of a shift. I need to re-check it.
Find Ivan Konev on Kurbatskoe field.

I suppose that the Architects do not alter time - they live in a different time dimension!

What do we know about them? Nothing really. Maybe they are creatures from another world, or maybe from another reality, where time flows differently. The collision of the realms creates time paradoxes and allows us to change the past.

To prove this theory and find a way to protect ourselves from the negative impact of the temporal magic, we need a living Architect, at least as powerful as an Archean!
She wants a living Achean? How am I going to get one?
Eliminate the bandits in the mountains, find the stolen ammunition and return to Ivan Konev.

We have only seen Archeans a couple of times. They only appear when we launch a broad-scale attack, but how do we do that without ammunition?

Ours scouts report that there is a gang of bandits in the mountains who rob our convoys. They must have our ammunition hidden somewhere!
The bandits must be hiding in the mountains!
They didn't touch the ammo or the money, but they took two barrels of rum! How cruel is that?
Join the Alliance's attack on the Architects, help the cannoneers aim the artillery, fight Archean and capture him. Report to Eladia.

So you need an Archean... Get ready, we are launching the advance! You better don't get into the thick of the battle. You should stay here and help the cannoneers aim at the enemy troops. As soon as an Archean shows up, you do what you have to do - whatever it is.
Don't worry about me and Unn. Just capture an Archean!

You did it! An intact, living Archean!

I will get all the information I need from him. I will reduce him to atoms, if I have to, but I will find a way to fight the bastards.
Interrogate the captured Archean and talk to Eladia.

You have some experience in speaking with the Architects, so why don't you try it now? The Architect is a very logical creature, I'd say, too logical. So you can lead it to a logical trap. We need to find out if there is a way to stop them!
So you want to try and speak with him? Alright, but don't say too much.

Ah, the Architects seem to be so easily fooled! Ascension, the Path of the Order.... What a nonsense.

But he said something important. That the Path has not been laid yet. We're only dealing with the vanguard... What will happen when it is finally laid?

We need to not let it happen. At any cost! If we don't defeat the Architect now, it may become too late.

The Path is not completed. The Universe is imperfect. Unpredictable. Chaotic.

I am the Order! I am the Architect, and I am the Path that leads to the Absolute. You cannot resist your predestination. Nothing can stop the Path!
h: Ask why the Order still hasn't defeated Chaos

t:
Your mind is poisoned with Chaos. It is weak. It is shattered.

You don't understand. The Path has not been laid yet. The Path is the Purpose. The Purpose is the Meaning. You cannot stop what has been predestined!

When I lay the Path into your Chaos-stricken world, you will perceive it. You will become a part of the Whole. This is your destiny!
h: Say that you have already stopped it

t: Kill the monsters in the passage, reach the other side of the mountains, find surviving soldiers in the Squirrel Grove, and use the beacon to summon Eladia.

If the Architect hadn't been lying - and I am not sure if they are capable of lying - then we're running out of time. The army is stuck on the battlefields and can't possibly reach the other side of the allod to destroy the Path anyway - there are way too many monsters on the shore.

There is this passage in the mountains, they call it the Road on the Bones. Legends say some dark creatures dwell in there, but I really doubt that they are more dangerous than the Architects. I will give you a beacon. When you reach the other side of the mountains and find a place for the camp, summon me - I will open the portal. Let's try and strike the Architects in the back and catch them off guard before they have laid their Path!

When you reach the other side of the mountains and find a place for the camp, summon me - I will open the portal. Let's try and strike the Architects in the back and catch them off guard before they have laid their Path!

Finally! What took you so long?

So what do we have there? Partisans? You don't say! I thought there were no survivors in the north. I should speak to their leader.
Meet Unn, survive the battle with the shadows of the future, and speak to the Seeress.

When this creature was talking to you, I managed to infiltrate its mind. It was scary! They really do have one consciousness, and they call themselves the Architect!

Can you meet me again in a couple of minutes on the meadow near the camp?
Don't be afraid, Weaver. Your thread is intertwined with that of Sarnaut!
I can see that the Tissue of Creation is solid like never before. Whatever awaits you in the future, it cannot deceive your Thread!
Enter the Distortion in the Squirrel Grove and help the partisans defeat the Architects.

A small squadron of Dane defenders faced the Architects here and was destroyed in an uneven struggle. Here the space once again is twisted in a dense spiral, which means we can try and change the past...
Yee ha! I bet they are wondering where that bomb came from!

Happy to hear that!

The plan is: we lure the monsters away from the camp - there where they cannot use their quantitative superiority, and then throw bombs on them. We have a whole crate of bombs!
Find the partisan squad in the Squirrel Grove and meet Sidor Kolpakov.

You should meet our commander, Sidor Kolpakov. He accepts everyone in our ranks - villagers, bandits, hunters - as long as they can hold a weapon.

Go to the north-east. You will find him there.

Sweet heavens! Are you from the capital? I thought no one would ever come to help us.

The enemies have some kind of a rally point on the shore, like a port. The flying ones circle around it in - thanks Tensess the tree crowns are thick here and they can't spot us! But still there are plenty of them on the ground, too, and the stupid ogres get in the way.
Meet Vasily Terkin in the Squirrel Grove near the ogre camp.

The Architects perturbed the ogre tribe that lives in this forest. They used to live quietly in the thicket, but now they harass our camp on a daily basis. I sent Vasily Terkin to keep an eye on them, and I would be very grateful if you could go and check if he is doing alright.
Kolpakov sent you? It's great to hear that! I could use some help.
Release the kidnapped partisans in the ogre camp and return to Vasily Terkin.

Our objective is not an easy one, but we can handle it, can't we?

The ogres have kidnapped several soldiers from our camp the last night. While they are thinking whether to stew or to roast them, we have to rescue them. I will distract the ogres, meanwhile you sneak up to the cages and release our fellows.
I will distract the ogres, meanwhile you sneak up to the cages and release our fellows.
This is the real soldiers' friendship! Thank you, friend!
Use the deserotype to take several pictures of the base in the Squirrel Grove and return to Eladia.

I spoke to the commander... His manners leave much to be desired, by the way.
